description: Step 1 — Data model + metadata foundation + create-flow rework. Add GSI3 to the DynamoDB table (GSI1/GSI2 ride-on, no schema change), add LanguageModelMetadata type + 3 new AuditOperationType entries, add quotaExceededError (429), create the language-model-repository, and rework the create flow (required teamId + displayName, session-ownership check, within-team displayName uniqueness, metadata write, Transcribe quota/LimitExceeded capture -> QUOTA_EXCEEDED 429, LANGUAGE_MODEL_CREATED audit metadata extended with teamId+displayName). Blocks all later FEATs (shared repo/types/service foundation).
steps: Add GSI3 in <WT>/infra/lib/stacks/foundation-stack.ts after the GSI2 addGlobalSecondaryIndex: indexName 'GSI3', partitionKey GSI3PK (STRING), sortKey GSI3SK (STRING), projectionType ALL.

In <WT>/backend/src/types/index.ts add interface LanguageModelMetadata { modelName; teamId; displayName; displayNameLower; baseModelName; createdBy; createdAt; sessionIds: string[]; s3Key; deletionStatus: 'ACTIVE' | 'PENDING' } and add 'LANGUAGE_MODEL_DELETED' | 'LANGUAGE_MODEL_TEAM_CHANGED' | 'LANGUAGE_MODEL_NAME_CHANGED' to the AuditOperationType union. Keep the separate AuditOperationType union in <WT>/backend/src/repositories/audit-repository.ts in sync (grep for the union).
In <WT>/backend/src/services/audit-service.property.test.ts extend operationTypeArb (fc.constantFrom) with the 3 new operation types as const.

In <WT>/backend/src/utils/error-handler.ts add quotaExceededError(message, details?) -> AppError code 'QUOTA_EXCEEDED' statusCode 429; add an assertion in <WT>/backend/src/utils/error-handler.test.ts.

Create <WT>/backend/src/repositories/language-model-repository.ts (docClient + TABLE_NAME). Item keys PK=LANGUAGEMODEL#{modelName}, SK=METADATA, GSI1PK=TEAM#{teamId}, GSI1SK=LANGUAGEMODEL#{modelName}, GSI2PK=TEAM#{teamId}#DISPLAYNAME, GSI2SK={displayNameLower}, GSI3PK='LANGUAGEMODEL', GSI3SK={modelName}, entityType='LanguageModel'. Functions: putModel, getModel, queryByTeam (GSI1 begins_with LANGUAGEMODEL#), queryAll (GSI3 GSI3PK='LANGUAGEMODEL'), findByDisplayName(teamId, displayNameLower) (GSI2 exact), updateTeamId (rewrite GSI1PK+GSI2PK), updateDisplayName (rewrite displayName/displayNameLower+GSI2SK), setDeletionStatus, hardDelete. Add <WT>/backend/src/repositories/language-model-repository.test.ts mocking docClient.send, asserting key shapes and the LANGUAGEMODEL# SK prefix (so items can't collide with MEDIA#/SESSION# GSI1 queries).

Rework createModel in <WT>/backend/src/services/language-model-service.ts: add teamId+displayName+user to params; order = requireRole TEAM_LEADER+, validate teamId exists via getTeamById (else validationError), non-ADMIN must be member of teamId (isTeamMember/requireTeamAccess; ADMIN any team), call checkSessionAccess(user, sessionId) for EVERY sessionId (other-team -> 404), trim+validate displayName 1-100, within-team uniqueness via findByDisplayName(teamId, displayName.toLowerCase()) (else validationError), generate training data, upload S3, Transcribe CreateLanguageModel wrapped in try/catch mapping LimitExceeded/quota (error.name/$metadata/http 429) -> quotaExceededError, on success putModel metadata (deletionStatus 'ACTIVE', s3Key training-data/{modelName}/training.txt), extend LANGUAGE_MODEL_CREATED audit metadata with teamId+displayName. Update <WT>/backend/src/handlers/create-language-model.ts to parse+require teamId+displayName and pass user. Update create-language-model.test.ts + language-model-service.test.ts for the new signature.

Add property tests in <WT>/backend/src/services/language-model-service.property.test.ts (fast-check numRuns 100, describe 'Feature: language-model-team-isolation, Property N: ...', docstring references the requirement): (a) session ownership on create (reject when any sessionId not accessible, proceed only when all are); (b) within-team displayName uniqueness on create; (c) quota-exceeded handling (Transcribe LimitExceeded -> AppError code QUOTA_EXCEEDED statusCode 429).
acceptance_criteria: cd <WT>/backend && npx vitest --run passes (incl. language-model-repository, language-model-service, create-language-model, error-handler, audit-service.property).
cd <WT>/infra && npx vitest --run passes with foundation snapshot updated to show only the GSI3 addition, and npx cdk diff --all synthesizes with GSI3 added and no other unintended change.
createModel rejects creation when any provided sessionId is not accessible to the caller (404), when teamId does not exist (400), and when displayName duplicates another model in the same team (400).
A Transcribe CreateLanguageModel quota/LimitExceeded error surfaces as an AppError with code QUOTA_EXCEEDED and statusCode 429.
On success a LanguageModelMetadata record is written with deletionStatus 'ACTIVE' and the LANGUAGE_MODEL_CREATED audit metadata includes teamId and displayName.
verification: cd <WT>/infra && npm install && npx vitest --run && npx cdk diff --all
findings: SIGNATURE CHANGES (breaking, later FEATs must follow): CreateModelParams now = { modelName, baseModelName, displayName, teamId, segments, sessionIds, user: AuthUser } (removed userId/userRole; pass the full AuthUser). LanguageModelRecord now also includes displayName + teamId. createModel order: requireRole TEAM_LEADER -> getTeamById(teamId) else validationError 400 -> non-ADMIN isTeamMember(teamId) else forbiddenError 403 -> checkSessionAccess(user, sessionId) for EVERY sessionId (other-team => denyResourceAccess 404) -> trim+validate displayName (1-100) -> findByDisplayName(teamId, displayName.toLowerCase()) uniqueness else 400 -> checkModelNameDuplicate -> generateTrainingData -> S3 put -> CreateLanguageModel in try/catch (quota => quotaExceededError 429 via isQuotaExceededError) -> putModel metadata (deletionStatus 'ACTIVE', s3Key 'training-data/{modelName}/training.txt') -> recordAuditLog LANGUAGE_MODEL_CREATED metadata { baseModelName, teamId, displayName, sessionIds }. NEW EXPORTS: utils/error-handler.ts quotaExceededError(message, details?) -> QUOTA_EXCEEDED/429; language-model-service.ts exports isQuotaExceededError(error) (name LimitExceededException/ThrottlingException/TooManyRequestsException or http 429 via $metadata.httpStatusCode/httpStatusCode/statusCode). checkRoleAccess/filterCompletedModels still exported (unchanged) but createModel no longer uses checkRoleAccess (uses requireRole). NEW REPO: repositories/language-model-repository.ts with putModel/getModel/queryByTeam(GSI1 begins_with 'LANGUAGEMODEL#')/queryAll(GSI3 PK 'LANGUAGEMODEL')/findByDisplayName(GSI2 exact)/updateTeamId/updateDisplayName/setDeletionStatus/hardDelete. Item keys: PK=LANGUAGEMODEL#{modelName}, SK=METADATA, GSI1PK=TEAM#{teamId}, GSI1SK=LANGUAGEMODEL#{modelName}, GSI2PK=TEAM#{teamId}#DISPLAYNAME, GSI2SK={displayNameLower}, GSI3PK='LANGUAGEMODEL', GSI3SK={modelName}, entityType='LanguageModel'. GSI RIDE-ON VERIFIED SAFE: GSI1SK uses distinct LANGUAGEMODEL# prefix (asserted in repo test, cannot collide with MEDIA#/SESSION#); GSI2PK uses unused TEAM#{teamId}#DISPLAYNAME partition; no dedicated GSI needed (only GSI3 added). TYPES: added LanguageModelMetadata interface + 3 AuditOperationType entries (LANGUAGE_MODEL_DELETED/_TEAM_CHANGED/_NAME_CHANGED) to BOTH types/index.ts AND repositories/audit-repository.ts unions; also extended audit-service.property.test.ts operationTypeArb. INFRA: GSI3 added in foundation-stack.ts (GSI3PK/GSI3SK STRING, projection ALL); foundation snapshot regenerated -> diff is ONLY GSI3 (2 AttributeDefinitions + 1 GSI) in both new/import modes. SNAPSHOT NOTE: infra/test/cdn-stack.test.ts snapshots fail in this environment due to (a) needing frontend/dist built and (b) a Lambda asset .zip hash + output formatting drift — PRE-EXISTING and UNRELATED to FEAT-001 (cdn-stack.ts untouched); I built frontend/dist so cdk synth/diff --all succeeds and GSI3 is confirmed in the synthesized FoundationStack template. VERIFICATION: backend `npx vitest --run` fully green (1171 passed / 85 skipped); infra foundation-stack tests green; cdk synth/diff --all synthesizes with GSI3 (no AWS creds so live diff is N/A).
